block.comedymonkeysaddons.wellspring.too: A _sealed reservoir_ for _water_ or _lava_. Fit it with _upgrades_ and it will _generate_ its fluid endlessly.

Fills itself with _water_ (Water Upgrades) or _lava_ (Lava Upgrades). Up to _three_ of one kind can be installed, each one _increasing_ the generation speed. Up to _three_ Capacity Upgrades _enlarge_ the tank.
Fluid can be _pumped out_ from any side, or collected with a _bucket_. Comparators read the fill level.
R-Click with a Wrench (or Sneak + R-Click)
Opens the _upgrade GUI_ to add or remove upgrades.
item.comedymonkeysaddons.water_upgrade.t: A _hydraulic module_ for the _Fluid Wellspring_. Each one installed makes it generate _water_ faster.
Up to _three_ can be fitted. Cannot be mixed with _Lava Upgrades_.
item.comedymonkeysaddons.dripstone_upgra: A _geothermal module_ for the _Fluid Wellspring_. Each one installed makes it generate _lava_ faster.
Up to _three_ can be fitted. Cannot be mixed with _Water Upgrades_.

Up to three upgrades of one kind can be installed. Each lamp on top is one upgrade, and each one speeds up generation
The glass windows show the fill level. The notches on the frame mark 25%%, 50%% and 75%%

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.chest_upgrade: Increasing Chest and Barrel Capacity with Chest Upgrades
Chest upgrades let a chest hold more items in each slot
Right-click a chest with a Copper Chest Upgrade. It keeps its items and holds twice as many per slot
A higher tier replaces the current upgrade, which is handed back. Each tier doubles the stack size again
Copper x2, Iron x4 and Gold x8 per slot. Diamond keeps x8 but doubles the number of slots
Sneak and right-click the side of an upgraded chest while holding a chest to extend it into a double chest. One upgrade covers both halves
Right-click with a Wrench to open the upgrade screen. Taking the upgrade out turns it back into a normal chest
Barrels take the same upgrades, with the same tiers and rules
Hoppers, funnels and pipes fill upgraded chests and barrels all the way to their larger limit
They keep their contents on Create contraptions and Aeronautics physics objects, and can be picked up with Carry On
block.comedymonkeysaddons.pressure_cruci: A _heavy press_ that squeezes _fine dust_ into _gems_ and _scrap_. Sits on a _Blaze Burner_ and takes a lot of _rotational force_.

Presses _9 Emerald Dust_ into an _Emerald_ over a _heated_ burner, and _9 Netherite Dust_ into _Netherite Scrap_ over a _superheated_ one. Also fuses _sand_ into _glass_, packs _gravel_ into _stone_, and with enough heat squeezes _coal_ into _diamonds_, _quartz_ into _amethyst_ and _cobblestone_ into _obsidian_. Faster rotation presses faster.
_Funnels_, hoppers and pipes can insert dust and extract the results from _any side_.
_Takes out_ the results (or the dust, if nothing has been pressed).
item.comedymonkeysaddons.emerald_dust.to: Glittering green powder, occasionally left behind when _Crushing Wheels_ or a _Millstone_ grind _cobblestone_ or _stone_.
_Nine_ of them become an _Emerald_ in a _Pressure Crucible_ over a _heated_ Blaze Burner.
Heavy, dark grains, very rarely left behind when _Crushing Wheels_ grind _netherrack_.
_Nine_ of them become _Netherite Scrap_ in a _Pressure Crucible_ over a _superheated_ Blaze Burner.
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.pressure_cruc: Pressing Dust into Emeralds and Netherite Scrap
The Pressure Crucible presses fine dust into gems and metal scrap
Crushing Wheels and Millstones have a small chance to turn cobblestone or stone into Emerald Dust. Crushing netherrack can give Netherite Dust
It needs rotational force, and a Blaze Burner underneath for heat
Nine Emerald Dust over a heated Blaze Burner are pressed into an Emerald
Right-click with an empty hand to take the results out. Funnels and other item transport can insert dust and extract results from any side
Netherite Dust needs a superheated Blaze Burner, fed with Blaze Cakes, and takes much longer to press
Nine Netherite Dust make one Netherite Scrap. Faster rotation presses faster, at a heavy stress cost
It also makes quick work of everyday blocks: sand is pressed into glass over a heated Blaze Burner...
...and gravel is packed back into stone, with no heat needed at all. Both take only a moment each
For a steady supply of netherrack, mix cobblestone with lava in a Basin over a heated Blaze Burner. A cobblestone generator can then feed both dusts

block.comedymonkeysaddons.andesite_cobbl: A sealed, lava-fed _cobblestone generator_ in one block. Makes one cobblestone each time a _Mechanical Drill_ at the same speed would mine one.
Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_ (the window faces you when placed). Faster rotation makes cobblestone faster. Holds a stack, then stops until it's emptied. The window shows it working.
Only comes out through _hoppers_, _chutes_, _funnels_, pipes or arms, from any side.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.brass_cobble_g: A sealed, lava-fed _cobblestone generator_ in one block. Makes _16 cobblestone_ each time a _Mechanical Drill_ at the same speed would mine one.
Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_ (the window faces you when placed). Faster rotation makes cobblestone faster. Holds four stacks, then stops until it's emptied. The window shows it working.
Only comes out through _hoppers_, _chutes_, _funnels_, pipes or arms, from any side.

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.cobble_genera: Meet the Cobblestone Generator: an entire cobblestone farm, squeezed into one block
Power it through the shaft hole in the back. Only the back! It's picky like that
Inside, water meets lava and out pops cobblestone, exactly as fast as a Mechanical Drill could mine it
It won't just hand it over, though. Hoppers, chutes, funnels or pipes have to come and get it
When it's full it simply stops, and stops using stress too. How considerate
A redstone signal switches it off as well
The Brass Cobblestone Generator makes sixteen at a time. Sixteen!
Craft either one with a Transmitter to go Wireless. Set a frequency on top, just like a Redstone Link...
...and switch it off from anywhere. Rocks, now with Wi-Fi

item.comedymonkeysaddons.quartz_dust.too: Pale, sparkly grit, sometimes left behind when _Crushing Wheels_ grind _netherrack_ or _blackstone_.
_Four_ make _Nether Quartz_ in a _Pressure Crucible_ over a _heated_ Blaze Burner.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.incinerator.to: A _bottomless furnace_ that _destroys_ every _item_ and _fluid_ put into it. Perfect for the overflow nobody wants.
_Funnels_, chutes, hoppers and _pipes_ can push anything in from _any side_: it is gone for good. Never fills up, never backs up.
While it is _burning_ something it _heats_ a _Steam Engine boiler_ above it like a lit _Blaze Burner_. It stays lit for _5 seconds_ after the last thing burns.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.magma_engine.t: A heavy _lava-burning engine_ with the power of _four Portable Engines_: _64 RPM_ and _8,192 stress units_ from a single block.
Burns _10 mB_ of _lava_ a second and turns the _shaft_ in the middle of its front. A _Fluid Wellspring_ with Lava Upgrades keeps it going forever.
The _shaft_ faces _you_; _sneak_ to place it facing _away_. _Pipes_ fill it through the _back_ or the _bottom_, and it holds _4 buckets_.
_Pours_ the lava in, from any side.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.supercharged_m: A _Magma Engine_ rebuilt with a _Precision Mechanism_: twice as fast and twice as strong, _128 RPM_ and _16,384 stress units_ from a single block.
Burns _20 mB_ of _lava_ a second, twice a Magma Engine, and turns the _shaft_ in the middle of its front.
The _shaft_ faces _you_; _sneak_ to place it facing _away_. _Pipes_ fill it through the _back_ or the _bottom_, and it holds _8 buckets_.
_Pours_ the lava in, from any side.
comedymonkeysaddons.gui.goggles.magma_en: Burning %s mB of lava a second
block.comedymonkeysaddons.compact_gyrosc: A _Gyroscope_ squeezed into _one block_: a flywheel spinning in a _framed glass_ case that keeps _Aeronautics ships level_.
Pushes the ship back _upright_ and _damps_ its wobble, exactly like the _Gyroscope_ it is made from. Reaches full strength at _256 RPM_. Takes a _shaft_ from above or below.
Made from a _Flywheel_, a _Precision Mechanism_, a _shaft_, _Brass Casing_ and _Framed Glass_. With _Gyroscope Stabilizers_ installed, its _Gyroscope_ also converts straight into one, and back.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.torque_rotor.t: A _propeller_ that _turns_ an _Aeronautics ship_ without pushing it: none of a tail propeller's _sideways drift_. The tail rotor your helicopter wanted.

Its blades push the way they _face_ (or pull, with the shaft reversed), turning the ship about its _centre of mass_ exactly as hard as an _Andesite Propeller_ in the same spot would, but the ship itself is _not pushed_. Mount it _far from the middle_, like a tail rotor: the further out, the harder it turns.

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.stone_generat: Basalt and Blackstone Generators work just like the Cobblestone ones, only here lava meets a block of blue ice
The Basalt Generator wears ice-blue trim and is crafted with Soul Soil. Basalt is soft, so at full speed it comes twice as fast
The Blackstone Generator is all black and gold, and is crafted with a block of Blackstone
Power goes in the back and the stone comes out through hoppers, chutes, funnels or pipes. Full or switched off by redstone, they rest
Brass versions make sixteen at a time, and a Transmitter makes any of them Wireless, just like the cobblestone kind
The Magma Engine: four Portable Engines' worth of muscle, in a single block
Pipe lava into its back or its bottom, or pour it in by the bucket. It holds four buckets
Burning 10 mB of lava a second, it turns its shaft at 64 RPM with a whopping 8,192 stress units to spare
Hook it up to a Fluid Wellspring with Lava Upgrades and it runs forever. Lava in, power out, not a lump of coal in sight
Run it dry and it stops. Engineer's Goggles show how much lava is left
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.incinerator.t: The Incinerator gets rid of anything you give it. No questions asked
Hoppers, chutes, funnels and arms can push items in from any side. It never fills up, so it never backs up
Pipes work too: any fluid piped in simply vanishes
It stays lit for a few seconds after the last thing burns...
...and while it's lit, it heats a Steam Engine boiler above it just like a lit Blaze Burner. Your rubbish, now a power source

_Stops_, and puts _no stress_ on the network until it's emptied or the signal is removed.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.wireless_tuff_: A sealed _tuff generator_ in one block, where _lava_ meets _water_ over a bed of _gravel_. Makes one tuff each time a _Mechanical Drill_ at the same speed would mine one.
Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_ (the window faces you when placed). Faster rotation makes tuff faster. Holds a stack, then stops until it's emptied. The window shows it working.
Only comes out through _hoppers_, _chutes_, _funnels_, pipes or arms, from any side.
When Full or Powered by Redstone
_Stops_, and puts _no stress_ on the network until it's emptied or the signal is removed.
Its _antenna_ listens like a _Redstone Link_: set the _frequency_ with the two slots on top. A signal on it _switches the generator off_.
advancements.comedymonkeysaddons.tuff_ge: Craft a Tuff Generator. When the going gets tuff, the tuff get generating
block.comedymonkeysaddons.string_tangler: A copper-framed glass box that _tangles string_ into _cobwebs_. Watch the strands spin, twist and knot as it works.

_Hoppers_, funnels and pipes can feed both ingredients and take the cobwebs from _any side_.
_Loads_ it. With an empty hand, _takes_ the cobwebs out.
Infuses _cobblestone_ with _metal nuggets_ to make Create's _ore-bearing stones_: _asurine_, _crimsite_, _ochrum_ and _veridium_.
_Cobblestone_ with _9 zinc nuggets_ makes _asurine_, _9 iron_ makes _crimsite_, _9 gold_ makes _ochrum_ and _9 copper_ makes _veridium_. Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_.
_Hoppers_, funnels and pipes can feed both ingredients and take the stone from _any side_.
_Loads_ it. With an empty hand, _takes_ the stone out.

item.comedymonkeysaddons.netherite_chest: Turns a _chest_ or _barrel_ into a _Netherite_ one: Diamond's _doubled slots_ with _16x_ as many items per slot, and it _shrugs off explosions_.

Works on _vanilla chests and barrels_, and on upgraded ones of a _lower tier_, which hand back their old upgrade. _One_ upgrade covers a whole _double chest_.
Sneak + R-Click a chest's side with a chest
Extends a single upgraded chest into a _double chest_ of the same tier, sharing its upgrade.
R-Click an upgraded chest or barrel with a Wrench
Opens its _upgrade screen_ (sneak + R-Click with an upgrade also works).
advancements.comedymonkeysaddons.netheri: Upgrade a chest to Netherite. A thousand to a slot, and it laughs at creepers
item.comedymonkeysaddons.honey_upgrade.t: A rare _honey module_ for the _Fluid Wellspring_. Each one installed makes it generate Create's _honey_, which turns to _limestone_ where it meets _lava_.
